/** The package of parsers. */
package com.example.parsing;

import java.util.List;

// Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

/**
 * Parses recipes.
 *
 * <p>Reads a recipe with {@link java.io.Reader} and returns its <code>Recipe</code>.
 *
 * @author Kapi
 * @see Formatter
 */
@Deprecated
public final class Parser {
    /** The source text. */
    private final String source = "";

    // A plain comment on a field.
    private int count;

    /**
     * Makes a parser.
     *
     * @param source the text to read
     */
    public Parser(String source) {}

    /**
     * Runs the parser.
     *
     * <pre>
     * new Parser("x").run();
     * </pre>
     *
     * @return the number of blocks
     * @throws IllegalStateException when the parser has stopped
     */
    @Override
    public int run() {
        /** Not documentation: a statement follows it. */
        int blocks = 0;
        return blocks; // a trailing comment
    }

    /** The kinds of block. */
    enum Kind {
        /** Plain text. */
        TEXT,
        CODE
    }

    /** A point. */
    record Point(int x, int y) {}

    interface Visitor {
        /** Visits a block. */
        void visit();
    }
}

/** A marker annotation. */
@interface Marker {
    /** Its value. */
    String value();
}
